utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is kicking off soon — folks are already dropping off tools and supplies. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Really? Can you confirm when it starts and where they’re collecting things?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t confirmed the exact start time yet, but I’ll ask around and let you know. I do know they’re collecting donations at the community center for now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and keep the plans moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I might’ve missed a few details, but I’m glad you’re keeping it moving. Let me know if you need me to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let you know if I need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the next repair item on the list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check the list while I’m out and see what’s next.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — just let me know when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much yet, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what’s needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’m still checking the list, but I’ll let you know what’s needed as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It starts at 9 a.m. on Saturday, and we’re aiming to wrap by early afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work—I can plan around the morning drop-off and help for a few hours. Do you need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing — I like a clear plan. What’s the repair drive schedule, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I haven’t pinned down the exact schedule yet, but I’ll check and let you know soon. If you can, just bring gloves, a screwdriver, and maybe a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll bring those and wait for the schedule. Let me know when you’ve got the time pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’d love to spread the word—when’s it happening?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not totally sure yet—I’m still waiting on the date and drop-off details. Once I have them, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, just send them my way when you have them—I’ll help spread the word fast.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—it's coming together nicely. I’m finalizing the volunteer list and the supply drop-off details now, and I’ll share the full schedule as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an ear out for the schedule and pass it along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m following along—what details do you want me to check for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you check which items need the most urgent repair and whether we have enough volunteers for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check both: the most urgent repair items and whether we have enough volunteers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a bit, but I need to keep things low-key right now. Let me know what’s needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — low-key is totally fine. I’ll send you the basics for the repair drive and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Just send me the basics when you can, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the repair drive needs tools, I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Can you bring any spare screwdrivers and a wrench?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring a couple spare screwdrivers and a wrench.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is set up—what location are we using?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m pretty sure it’s set up over by the community center, but I’d want to double-check the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll check the community center and confirm the exact spot before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand or a tool if you need one for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that if I hit a snag.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just give me a holler if you get stuck — I’ve got a toolbox ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the exact time, pickup spot, and what I should bring so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, fair enough — can you confirm the time and pickup spot, and let me know if I should bring tools or just myself?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do that once we get the details sorted — please send me the exact time, pickup spot, and whether any tools are needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — could you share the flyer with your building chat and mention the tools drop-off this Saturday? I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll post the flyer in my building chat and mention the tools drop-off this Saturday. Happy to help!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I may be a bit late, but I can help once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a quick inventory and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout—folks are bringing tools and extra hands. If you want, I can swing by and tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be wonderful, Tess—thank you. If you stop by, please let me know what they still need and I’ll see what I can do around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Faye—I’ll stop by and ask what they’re short on, then come straight back to you. I’ll keep an eye out for anything the school run folks can help with too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mostly volunteers with tools and a little time — folks who can help sort jobs, do quick fixes, or follow up on the bigger repairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help round up a few people and tools. What time should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what part of the repair drive do you want to work on?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can handle the tool pickup and sorting. Just point me to the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — head to the community shed first, then swing by the hardware drop-off after that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Nell, I’m glad you mentioned it — I’ve already started telling folks about the repair drive. If you want, I can help round up a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be really helpful, Quinn—thanks. I’m still catching up on the details, so I’d appreciate any updates you hear.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know right away if I hear anything new. I’ll also ask around for a few more volunteers tonight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet, but I can keep track of where the repair drive is happening and let you know as soon as I hear. If you want, I can also note the time and address for us.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Please do—just tell me the time and address when you know, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and share the time and address as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, how’s the repair drive going? Did you need anything from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — it’s going okay, but I want to double-check the details before I ask for anything. I’ll let you know if I need something.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, just let me know if you want me to help with anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’ll check around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate you checking around. If you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.
